svg.aria-label: CTA-local TMA loads. Left, the cluster form today: a generic *mut u8 destination that the lowering converts to the cluster window (addrspace(7)), and on sm_120a a ptxas runtime CTA check whose call drops setmaxnreg. Middle, SharedPtr<T>: a shared-memory pointer whose address space is part of its type, with its constructors and methods, three non-inlined helpers of the shared_memory_helper example, and the LLVM IR that keeps ptr addrspace(3) in their parameters and return type. Right, the new _g2s_cta form: the same call with a SharedPtr<u8> destination, the typed llvm.nvvm.cp.async.bulk.tensor.g2s.cta.tile.2d intrinsic on the LLVM NVPTX route, inline .shared::cta PTX on the libNVVM route, and what is refused at compile time. Bottom, the PTX of both forms and what ptxas makes of them on sm_120a: 24 registers with CALL.ABS.NOINC against 168 registers with USETMAXREG kept.

text.style: font: 600 17px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: CTA-local TMA loads: a shared pointer that is shared by type, and the .shared::cta copy form

svg.text: The cluster form converts a generic *mut u8 to the cluster window; on sm_120a ptxas adds a runtime CTA check whose call drops setmaxnreg. The CTA form takes a SharedPtr<u8>.
